blocks.en: We now assert that the techniques and results developed for analytic functions in a standard complex variables course can be used with impunity on analytic functions with values in a Banach space. For a more thorough development of this idea; see e.g., \cite{DS}. As an example of an application of old techniques in this new setting we now prove the following.
blocks.zh: 现在断言, 标准复变函数课程中对解析函数建立的方法和结果, 可以放心地用于取值于 Banach 空间的解析函数. 对这一思想更深入的阐述, 例如可参见 \cite{DS}. 作为将已有方法用于这一新背景的例子, 下面证明以下结果.
